items.source: Creates a new instance of OpenTelemetryResourceAttributes.
items.translation: 创建一个新的OpenTelemetryResourceAttributes实例。

items.source: Additionally, spring.application.name or unknown_service will be used as the default for service.name, and spring.application.group will serve as the default for service.group and service.namespace.
items.translation: 此外，`spring.application.name` 或 `unknown_service` 将作为 `service.name` 的默认值，而 `spring.application.group` 将作为 `service.group` 和 `service.namespace` 的默认值。

items.source:
If a key exists in both environment variables and user-defined resources, the value
from the user-defined resource takes precedence, even if it is empty.
items.translation: 如果键同时存在于环境变量和用户定义的资源中，则用户定义资源中的值优先，即使该值为空。

items.source: consumer - the BiConsumer to apply
items.translation: consumer - 要应用的 BiConsumer

items.source: resourceAttributes - user-provided resource attributes to be used
items.translation: resourceAttributes - 用户提供的用于使用的资源属性

items.source: Applies resource attributes to the provided BiConsumer after being combined from environment variables and user-defined resource attributes.
items.translation: 将资源属性应用于提供的 BiConsumer，这些属性是在从环境变量和用户定义的资源属性组合后应用的。
